I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to him on November 3, 2025.

That date comes from Moss's Nov 2, 2025 Coastal digest and the Pellucid cutover recap, which give the same date. I also told him that, per the recap, Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21 and he fully took over on Nov 22. He can use that date only if the CRM needs the day-to-day handover.
